description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon3d/rules/face_flux_divergence_lev_massform_noflux_bc -- the MASS-FORM vertical flux divergence for a moving (terrain-following) grid. Pins that each of the three regions lowers to the RAW face-flux difference M_{k+1/2} - M_{k-1/2} with NO trailing division by a thickness (the fixed-grid sibling face_flux_divergence_lev_noflux_bc divides every region by dz), and that the ground (k=1) and model-top (k=NLEV) walls omit their absent face flux. This is the exact q==1 limit of ppm_flux_D_lev_mono_hybrid_noflux_bc.
